newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Former Pakistan MP shot in Punjab province.
newsitem.headline: Former Pakistan MP shot in Punjab province.

text.p: Gunmen shot and critically wounded a former Pakistani parliament member on Thursday in Gujrat town in the central province of Punjab, police said.
They said Ghazanfar Gul, a member of former prime minister Benazir Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party (PPP), was shot when driving to home by car.
There was no immediate information about the indentity of the gunmen or the motive of the attack.
The shooting coincided with a meeting of new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's cabinet in Islamabad to dicuss what a government statedment called the "deteriorating law and order situation".

Gul, a former member of the National Assembly (lower house), had lost his contest for the same seat in the February 3 elections, in which the PPP suffered a crushing defeat by Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League party.
Gujrat is also the home town of new Interior Minister Shujaat Hussain.
